lines.en: label yumidorm5:
I knock on Yumi’s door, knowing well that she likely won’t respond.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Yumi 的门，心里很清楚她多半不会回应。

lines.en: But, on the off chance that she confuses me for a delivery man or something, maybe I’ll get to spend some time with her after all.
lines.zh: 不过，万一她把我错当成外卖员什么的，说不定我反而能跟她待上一会儿。

lines.en: Even if it’s only for a few seconds...
lines.zh: 哪怕只有几秒钟……

lines.en: : Who is it?
lines.zh: : 谁啊？

lines.en: "Yumi speaks through the door in a rather blasé sort of way. Not angry, not
lines.zh: 「Yumi 隔着门说话的语气相当漫不经心。不生气，也不

lines.en: enthusiastic, just...disinterested."
lines.zh: 热情，只是……提不起兴趣。」

lines.en: : Uhh...delivery for Yumi Yamaguchi?
lines.zh: : 呃……给 Yumi Yamaguchi 的快递？

lines.en: : You think I don’t recognize your voice, douchebag?
lines.zh: : 你以为我听不出你的声音吗，蠢货？

lines.en: : I’m sorry miss, you must have me confused for someone else.
lines.zh: : 抱歉小姐，您一定是把我和别人搞混了。

lines.en: : Yeah? Then what are you delivering?
lines.zh: : 是吗？那你送的是什么？

lines.en: : A...pizza?
lines.zh: : 一份……披萨？

lines.en: : I didn’t order a fucking pizza.
lines.zh: : 我他妈的又没点披萨。

lines.en: : Someone must have ordered it for you.
lines.zh: : 那可能是有人替您点的。

lines.en: Yumi slams her foot or her fist or something against the door, shaking the walls of the entire dorm.
lines.zh: Yumi 用脚、或者拳头、还是别的什么，狠狠砸在门上，震得整栋宿舍的墙都在晃。

lines.en: Weird. This place seems relatively new. Is the anger of a[school]-delinquent really enough to send it spiraling into disrepair?
lines.zh: 奇怪。这地方看起来还挺新的。一个[school]不良少女的怒气，真够把它折腾成危房吗？

lines.en: : Listen up, asshole. I don’t know what makes you think I’m going to let you in my room, but if you don’t leave right now, I’m calling the cops.
lines.zh: : 听好了，混蛋。我不知道你哪来的自信觉得我会让你进我的房间，但你要是现在不走，我就要报警了。

lines.en: : You threaten to call the cops pretty much every time we associate and haven’t done it yet. I’m going to take my chances.
lines.zh: : 我们每次打交道你都威胁要报警，可你一次也没报过。我赌一把。

lines.en: : Well...that’s just because I hate cops just as much as you! Fucking pigs can all get bent for all I care.
lines.zh: : 那……那只是因为我恨警察的程度跟你一样深！那些该死的猪爱怎么着就怎么着，我才不在乎。

lines.en: I have no idea how she hasn’t noticed this exchange, yet...
lines.zh: 我真不知道她怎么就没察觉到这段对话里的矛盾，不过……

lines.en: else:
: Can you at least open the door? I’m starting to feel kind of uncomfortable out here.
lines.zh: : 你至少能把门打开吗？我站在外面开始有点不自在了。

lines.en: scene ftpreduxangry
Yumi aggressively storms her way out of the room and grabs the collar of my shirt.
lines.zh: Yumi 气势汹汹地冲出房间，一把抓住我衬衫的领子。

lines.en: : Just fucking...come with me if you need to talk to me that desperately. I don’t want people to think the two of us are friends.
lines.zh: : 真是见鬼……你要真这么急着跟我说话，就跟我来。我可不想让别人觉得我们俩是朋友。

lines.en: : Won’t it also look weird if you’re dragging me through the halls?
lines.zh: : 可你这么拖着我穿过走廊，看起来不也一样奇怪吗？

lines.en: : Are you fucking coming or not?!
lines.zh: : 你他妈的到底来不来？！

lines.en: scene ftpreduxgone
Yumi lets go of my shirt and storms down the hallway. I’m left with no choice but to follow after her...
lines.zh: Yumi 松开我的衬衫，怒气冲冲地沿着走廊走了。我没有别的选择，只能跟上去……

lines.en: scene black
scene yumioutside1
I wind up following Yumi several blocks away to a small shopping plaza that has already shut down for the night.
lines.zh: 最后我跟 Yumi 走了几个街区，来到一家已经打烊的小购物广场。

lines.en: She comes to an abrupt stop in front of a restaurant, scans the area to make sure no one is around, and then proceeds to scream at me because she is Yumi and that is what she does.
lines.zh: 她在一间餐厅前猛地停下，扫视一圈确认四周没人，然后开始冲我大吼大叫——因为她是 Yumi，而这就是她会做的事。

lines.en: : What do you want?!
lines.zh: : 你到底想怎样？！

lines.en: The ska music starts playing again.
lines.zh: 斯卡音乐又响了起来。

lines.en: : Just wanted to see if you were in the mood to hang out.
lines.zh: : 就是想看看你有没有心情出来待会儿。

lines.en: : Why?!
lines.zh: : 为什么？！

lines.en: : Because I want to spend time with you.
lines.zh: : 因为我想和你待在一起。

lines.en: : Because...uhh...
: Sorry, what answer could I give right now that would make you the least mad at me?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我现在给出什么答案，才能让你最不生气？

lines.en: scene yumioutside2
: Jesus Christ, you’re out of your fucking mind.
lines.zh: : 天哪，你他妈是疯了吧。

lines.en: : Didn’t you get the hint after I freaked out on you about that fucking disgusting kiss you forced on me?
lines.zh: : 上次你硬塞给我那个恶心的吻，我对你大发雷霆——你还没看出暗示吗？

lines.en: : I don’t want to be around you. Ever.
lines.zh: : 我不想待在你身边。永远都不想。

lines.en: : Then why didn't you just stay in your dorm?
lines.zh: : 那你为什么不干脆待在宿舍里？

lines.en: scene yumioutside3
: Because I didn’t want fuckin’ Chika or somebody else thinkin’ that we actually spend time together! Is that really so hard to believe?!
lines.zh: : 因为我不想让 Chika 或者别的什么人觉得我们真的会一起出去！这有那么难相信吗？！

lines.en: scene yumioutside1
: Isn’t it enough for you that you’re already fucking like...half the girls in our class?
lines.zh: : 你已经跟我们班……一半的女生上过床了，还不够吗？

lines.en: : Jesus, I wouldn’t even be surprised if you had your fucking [niece] groomed already.
lines.zh: : 天哪，就算你连自己的[niece]都调教好了，我也一点都不惊讶。

lines.en: To be fair, Ami doesn't really require much...{i}grooming.{/i}
lines.zh: 说句公道话，Ami 其实也不太需要……{i}调教{/i}。

lines.en: : I’m not ‘fucking half the class,’ Yumi...If I was, do you really think I’d be spending my time trying to talk to you?
lines.zh: : 我可没有“跟半个班”上床，Yumi……如果我真那样了，你觉得我还会在这儿花时间跟你说话吗？

lines.en: scene yumioutside4
: I don’t fucking know. Probably?
lines.zh: : 我他妈怎么知道。大概吧？

lines.en: : Don’t guys think of girls like fuckin’ trophies or whatever? That’s how it’s always seemed to me, at least.
lines.zh: : 男人不都把女人当成什么战利品之类的吗？至少在我看来一直是这样。

lines.en: : What do you mean by that?
lines.zh: : 你这话什么意思？

lines.en: : I’ve just been hangin’ around mostly guys for years now and all they ever talk about is girls and shit. It’s annoying as fuck.
lines.zh: : 我这些年基本上都跟男的混在一起，他们嘴里除了女人就是些破事。烦死人了。

lines.en: Oh, right. I forgot that was a thing.
lines.zh: 哦，对。我差点忘了还有这么回事。

lines.en: : Do you have {i}any{/i} female friends other than Chika?
lines.zh: : 除了 Chika，你{i}还有{/i}别的女性朋友吗？

lines.en: scene yumioutside1
: Why does it fucking matter what kinds of friends I have? Why do you want to know?
lines.zh: : 我交什么样的朋友关你他妈的屁事？你为什么想知道？

lines.en: : I just think it sounds kind of lonely not really having anyone to talk to.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得，连个能说话的人都没有，听起来挺孤独的。

lines.en: : And I think it's time for you to mind your own fucking business!
lines.zh: : 我觉得你该去管好你自己他妈的事了！

lines.en: : I’m perfectly fine on my own. Always have been, always will be.
lines.zh: : 我一个人过得很好。一直都是，以后也会是。

lines.en: scene yumioutside4
: Besides, why the fuck would some random ass dudes vanishing make shit any worse for me? If anything, life’s gotten kinda easier since they've been gone.
lines.zh: : 再说，几个随便的男人消失了，凭什么就能让我过得更糟？说真的，他们走了以后，日子反而轻松了点。

lines.en: : Don’t gotta worry about all the bullshit like how I should be more ‘girly’ or whatever. Fuck that. I’ll be however I wanna be.
lines.zh: : 不用再为那些破事操心，比如我该怎么更“女孩子气”什么的。去他妈的。我想怎么样就怎么样。

lines.en: : Good. More power to you.
lines.zh: : 很好。支持你。

lines.en: : Just don’t go causing too much trouble. I’m pretty sure Chika doesn’t have the money to bail you out of jail if you get arrested.
lines.zh: : 只是别惹太多麻烦。你要是被抓了，我敢肯定 Chika 可没钱把你保出来。

lines.en: scene yumioutside5
: Pfft. Fuck gettin’ arrested. Ain’t no pig doin' shit about me. If they were gonna arrest me, I’d have been locked up years ago.
lines.zh: : 切。被抓？去他妈的。没有哪头猪能把我怎么样。要是他们真要抓我，我几年前就进去了。

lines.en: : For what? Picking the locks on those pachinko machines you told me about?
lines.zh: : 因为什么？就因为你跟我说过的，撬那些弹珠机的锁？

lines.en: scene yumioutside1
: Quit it with the fuckin' pachinko machines! I don't see {i}you{/i} out there strugglin' to make a fuckin' life for yourself!
lines.zh: : 别他妈提弹珠机了！我可没见{i}你{/i}为了混口饭吃有多拼命！

lines.en: : I still don’t even get why you dragged me out here in the first place if we’re gonna just talk about which laws I break and shit!
lines.zh: : 我到现在都没搞懂，你把我拖到这儿来，就为了聊我犯了哪条法之类的破事！

lines.en: : Are you a cop?! Because you're acting a lot like a fuckin' cop right now.
lines.zh: : 你是警察吗？！因为你现在他妈的表现得就像一个警察。

lines.en: : I would be an extremely bad cop.
lines.zh: : 我要是当警察，那也是个烂到家的警察。

lines.en: : Yeah, well you're an extremely bad teacher too and that hasn't stopped you.
lines.zh: : 是啊，你当老师也烂到家了，可那也没拦住你啊。

lines.en: : Listen dude, I already told you I’m not gonna fuck you. So just get the hell outta here and let me go home.
lines.zh: : 听着，老兄，我说过了我不会跟你上床。所以赶紧滚吧，让我回家。

lines.en: : I’m beginning to think you aren’t having fun tonight.
lines.zh: : 我开始觉得你今晚玩得并不开心。

lines.en: scene yumioutside6
: {i}I wonder if kickin’ him in the dick would give me enough time to get away...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我在想，朝他裆上来一脚，能不能给我争取到足够的时间跑掉……{/i}

lines.en: : I can hear you, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 我听得见，Yumi。

lines.en: : Just tell me what I can do to get on better terms with you.
lines.zh: : 你就告诉我，我怎么做才能跟你处得更好一点。

lines.en: : Well, you could stop callin’ me to your office for one.
lines.zh: : 首先，你可以别再把我叫去你的办公室。

lines.en: : Hey. I may suck at being a teacher, but I can’t just {i}not{/i} do anything about you bullying the other girls.
lines.zh: : 嘿。我当老师可能很烂，但你欺负{i}别{/i}的女生，我不可能什么都不做。

lines.en: : Right. Because you’re fucking them and need to keep ‘em happy so they’ll let you shove your gross-ass micropenis inside.
lines.zh: : 对啊。因为你跟她们有一腿，得把她们哄高兴了，她们才肯让你把你那根恶心的迷你小阴茎塞进去。

lines.en: : Yumi, I can assure you that I do not have a micropenis.
lines.zh: : Yumi，我可以向你保证，我没有迷你小阴茎。

lines.en: scene yumioutside1
: Whatever, doesn't mean it's not gross.
lines.zh: : 随你怎么说，反正它一样恶心。

lines.en: : So other than letting you bully everyone, what else can I do?
lines.zh: : 那么，除了放任你欺负所有人，我还能做什么？

lines.en: scene yumioutside4
: How am I supposed to know? I can’t just fuckin’ decide to like you when I’ve gotten so used to treatin’ you like this.
lines.zh: : 我他妈怎么知道？我都已经习惯这么对你了，总不能说喜欢就喜欢吧。

lines.en: : Specially not with all the shit you've done to me.
lines.zh: : 尤其是你还对我干过那些破事。

lines.en: : People don’t just fuckin' change overnight, man. You’re not some...magical fucking exception to that.
lines.zh: : 人是不可能一夜之间就他妈改变的好吗。你也不是什么……神奇的他妈的例外。

lines.en: I beg to differ, but I'm not about to unload my weird circumstances onto Yumi when even I don't understand them yet.
lines.zh: 我不敢苟同，但连我自己都还没搞懂那些怪事，我可不想把它们倒给 Yumi。

lines.en: : I know that people don’t change overnight. But I’ve been following you around for weeks now trying to get to know you.
lines.zh: : 我知道人不会一夜之间改变。可我跟着你转了好几个星期，就是想了解你。

lines.en: scene yumioutside1
: Right. And you also almost pushed me over a goddamn guardrail while mouth-[raping] me. Real good job of gettin’ to know me.
lines.zh: : 是啊。你还一边强吻我，一边差点把我推下该死的护栏。了解得可真够到位的。

lines.en: if chikadorm10 == True:
: Weird things keep happening in that part of town.
lines.zh: : 那一带总发生些奇怪的事。

lines.en: : And while I know that isn't an excuse, it-
lines.zh: : 虽然我知道那不能当借口，但它——

lines.en: scene yumioutside6
: No, I'm calling bullshit. That {i}is{/i} an excuse.
lines.zh: : 不，我说是放屁。那{i}就是{/i}借口。

lines.en: : I’m not gonna fuckin' believe that you just...turn into somebody else based on what part of the city you're in. Get real.
lines.zh: : 我他妈才不会相信你会因为在哪半个城区就变成另一个人。别扯了。

lines.en: else:
: Again, I’m sorry about that. Something...came over me.
lines.zh: : 再说一次，那件事我很抱歉。有什么……上了我的身。

lines.en: : Yeah, it’s called a fuckin’ hard-on. Learn to control yourself.
lines.zh: : 是啊，那东西叫勃起。学会管好你自己。

lines.en: : All I’m saying is that I think you wouldn’t hate me so much if you tried to talk to me without insulting me every once in a while.
lines.zh: : 我只是想说，我觉得如果你偶尔试着不骂我、跟我好好说话，你不会这么恨我。

lines.en: scene yumioutside4
: Impossible. Just seeing you makes me feel sick to my stomach.
lines.zh: : 不可能。光是看见你我就觉得恶心。

lines.en: : Are you sure you aren’t in love with me? That could also cause you to feel a little-
lines.zh: : 你确定你不是爱上我了吗？那也会让你觉得有点——

lines.en: scene yumioutside7
: In LOVE with you?! Are you fucking drunk?!
lines.zh: : 爱上你？！你他妈是喝醉了吗？！

lines.en: : No. I actually chose to visit the dorms {i}instead{/i} of the bar tonight.
lines.zh: : 没有。我今晚是特意选了来宿舍，{i}没去酒吧{/i}。

lines.en: : Well it sure fuckin’ sounds like you are! I don’t give a shit about {i}love{/i} or {i}feelings{/i} or ANY of that fucking nonsense!
lines.zh: : 那你他妈听起来就是喝醉了！我他妈才不在乎什么{i}爱{/i}不爱的、感不{i}感觉{/i}的，那些狗屁玩意儿！

lines.en: : That kinda shit is for Chika! You wanna hang around a girl who’s actually got a chance to fall for you? Hit {i}her{/i} up. Not me.
lines.zh: : 那种东西是留给 Chika 的！你想找个真有可能喜欢上你的女孩？去找{i}她{/i}。别找我。

lines.en: : And shit, dude. For all I know, you could be fucking her already as well. God knows it might get her to fuckin' relax a little.
lines.zh: : 再说了，老兄。说不定你已经在操她了，谁知道呢。天知道那样也许能让她放松一点。

lines.en: if chikatownfirst == True:
I can...definitely see myself doing that soon enough. But there are other issues at hand here.
lines.zh: 我……确实能看到自己在不久之后那么做。但眼下还有别的问题。

lines.en: : Yumi, I can promise you now that I have not fucked your roommate.
lines.zh: : Yumi，我现在可以向你保证，我没跟你室友上过床。

lines.en: else:
: Yumi, I can promise you now that I have not fucked your roommate.
lines.zh: : Yumi，我现在可以向你保证，我没跟你室友上过床。

lines.en: scene yumioutside4
: Whatever. Not like I fucking care since I know you want to.
lines.zh: : 随你怎么说。反正我也不在乎，因为我知道你想。

lines.en: : At least she’s smart enough to not let some assclown like you screw her over.
lines.zh: : 至少她够聪明，不会让你这种混球占了便宜。

lines.en: : Chika woulda cut your fuckin’ head off if you were to pull the same kinda shit you pulled with me.
lines.zh: : 你要是敢对我搞你对我搞过的那套，Chika 会砍了你的头。

lines.en: In a rare moment of what seems like vulnerability, Yumi puts herself down in favor of Chika.
lines.zh: 在一个罕见的、看起来像是示弱的瞬间，Yumi 贬低了自己，抬高了 Chika。

lines.en: But why?
lines.zh: 可为什么呢？

lines.en: : Are you saying that Chika is stronger than you?
lines.zh: : 你是说 Chika 比你坚强？

lines.en: : That’s absolutely not what I fuckin’ said...
lines.zh: : 我他妈绝对不是那个意思……

lines.en: : I’d kick Chika's ass in a fight, but that's not what this is about.
lines.zh: : 打架的话我肯定能把 Chika 揍趴下，但事情不是这个。

lines.en: : She deals with shit much differently than I do. She’s always doin’ things head-on and I’m-
lines.zh: : 她处理事情的方式跟我完全不一样。她总是正面硬刚，而我——

lines.en: scene yumioutside8
: ...tch. Who the fuck even knows? Not like it matters.
lines.zh: : ……啧。谁他妈知道呢。反正也不重要。

lines.en: : You sure you don’t want to go on with that? It sounded like you were going to finally start opening up to me for a second.
lines.zh: : 你确定不想继续说下去吗？听起来你刚才有那么一瞬间终于要对我敞开心扉了。

lines.en: scene yumioutside5
: Heh. Dream on, asshole. That’s already more than you were supposed to get tonight.
lines.zh: : 呵。做你的梦去吧，混蛋。今晚你得到的已经够多了。

lines.en: : You’re lucky I pitied you enough to follow you out here.
lines.zh: : 算你走运，我可怜你，才跟着你走到这儿来。

lines.en: Does she really not remember that she's the one who led {i}me{/i}?...
lines.zh: 她真的不记得是她带{i}我{/i}来的吗？……

lines.en: : Yup. Sure am. That’s why I’m not going to push you any further tonight.
lines.zh: : 是啊，确实。所以今晚我不会再逼你了。

lines.en: : You’ll come around to me eventually. I think I just need to keep annoying you until you break.
lines.zh: : 你迟早会接受我的。我觉得我只要一直烦你，直到你崩溃就行。

lines.en: : It’s gonna take a lot more than just followin’ me around to break me, you know? I’m not like the girls you spend most of your time with.
lines.zh: : 光是跟着我转，可远远不够让我崩溃，你知道吗？我可不像你花大部分时间陪的那些女生。

lines.en: : Exactly. Which is one of the many reasons I’m trying to get closer to you.
lines.zh: : 没错。这也是我想跟你拉近关系的众多理由之一。

lines.en: : Well, as long as none of those reasons are turning me into your pet or whatever the fuck you’re doing to all those girls-
lines.zh: : 行吧，只要那些理由里不包括把我变成你的宠物，或者你正对那些女生做的随便什么破事——

lines.en: : I guess there are...worse things out there.
lines.zh: : 我觉得……还有更糟的呢。

lines.en: : You’re still a little bitch, though. And I’ll cut your fucking dick off if you kiss me again.
lines.zh: : 不过你还是个小混蛋。你要是再敢亲我，我就把你的鸡巴割下来。

lines.en: : Understood...
lines.zh: : 明白了……

"I try to walk Yumi back to the dorm, but she says something about how she’s

lines.en: "Already exhausted from being yelled at so much, I submit and give her a few

lines.en: I just wonder what made her like that.
